title: Commercial Fusion 2026: From Tokamak Assembly to Tritium-Breeding Plant
subtitle: Six sector modules sit in the ITER pit, but Q>1, TBR>1 and an NRC licensing pathway are still unbuilt.

current_gaps.title: Unproven Net Energy Gain
current_gaps.spec: No private device has reached Q>1; only NIF exceeds gain factor one

current_gaps.title: No Closed Tritium Cycle
current_gaps.spec: Closed tritium cycle absent: lithium blanket TBR>1 unproven, reprocessing undefined

current_gaps.title: 14 MeV Material Void
current_gaps.spec: No structural or plasma-facing alloy qualified against 14 MeV neutron damage

current_gaps.title: Funding Below Authorisation
current_gaps.spec: FY2027 FES appropriation $790M undercuts $805.7M enacted and $1.1B authorized

current_gaps.title: Absent Licensing Pathway
current_gaps.spec: No NRC fusion-specific licensing rule; permitting pathway for plant siting unresolved

evolution_matrix.key_upgrade: Replaces short-pulse physics shots with sustained burning-plasma operation at ITER's ignition point.
Replaces purchased tritium inventory with lithium breeding blankets engineered for TBR>1.
Replaces fission-surrogate irradiation campaigns with 14 MeV neutron qualification of alloys.
Replaces low-temperature NbTi windings with REBCO high-temperature superconducting tapes.
Replaces case-by-case fission precedent with an NRC fusion-specific rule and siting pathway.

core_pillars.title: Burning-Plasma Core
core_pillars.concise_spec: D-T ignition per Lawson criterion; ITER target 500 MW, final sector mid-2027

core_pillars.title: Tritium Fuel Cycle
core_pillars.concise_spec: Closed loop: lithium blanket TBR>1, 12.3-year half-life, tritium reprocessing plant

core_pillars.title: Neutron-Resistant Materials
core_pillars.concise_spec: Structural and plasma-facing alloys rated against 14 MeV neutron flux, DOE milestones

core_pillars.title: HTS Magnet Systems
core_pillars.concise_spec: REBCO tapes, 20 K cryogenics, 330-tonne TF coils through full-current trials

core_pillars.title: Licensing & Deployment
core_pillars.concise_spec: 28 US developers, $14.24B raised, NRC rulemaking timed to mid-2030s grid

expansion_stages.label: Component
expansion_stages.detail: One module: 440-t vessel sector, two 310-t coils, millimetre alignment

expansion_stages.label: Machine
expansion_stages.detail: Nine modules welded into a torus; sector 3 carries 120 field sensors

expansion_stages.label: Fleet
expansion_stages.detail: Public-private partnerships expand supply chain; DOE milestones gate funding

expansion_stages.label: Global
expansion_stages.detail: Dozens of plant concepts tracked; HTS flagged as commercialisation lever

validation_benches.title: Ignition Margin
validation_benches.test_criteria: Pass if D-T plasma sustains Lawson triple product ≥3×10^21 keV·s/m³ at ignition

validation_benches.title: Tritium Breeding Ratio
validation_benches.test_criteria: Pass if lithium blanket campaign returns TBR ≥1.05 across 12 months of D-T operation

validation_benches.title: Magnet Full-Current
validation_benches.test_criteria: Pass if the 330-tonne toroidal field coil completes full-current trial without a quench

validation_benches.title: Sector Alignment
validation_benches.test_criteria: Pass if all 9 sector modules align to ≤2 mm tolerance, final lift under 30 hours
